subject: REQUEST compute (air_bridge.rs): cache metal2vulkan plan() by BindShape in generic_plan_mode
body: Encode CPU evidence (host, thread-CPU clock, -O2, 200-draw CA command): tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized costs ~18 us/draw host (device several x) and is now the largest per-draw encode cost. The frontend now has an exact C memo keyed on full planner inputs (render_pipeline.inc tegu_render_plan_generic_cached, host builds verify every hit byte-for-byte): 99% hits with stable offsets, but with ring-buffer uniform offsets (unique per draw, like CA) hits drop to 24% (505/2074) and plan_ms returns to 3.6 ms/200 draws. The translator is designed for this: BindShape (state.rs) abstracts buffer offsets to offset_alignment + length_class, and BindState::position_of_shape/has_shape exist so 'a consumer that keeps the shapes it made can find a state's among them without allocating'. PROPOSAL (exact by API contract): in generic_plan_mode keep in RenderPipelineHandle a small Mutex<Vec<(BindShape, Plan)>> (e.g. 8, LRU); after building  (incl. the layout-slot overwrite), find via state.position_of_shape(...) or shape equality, reuse the Plan, then run instantiate_draw + the projection as today. plan() depends on (pipeline, device, shape) only. No ABI change; the C memo stays as a first-level cache. Please measure before/after with gpu/build/c6f-lowering-20261026/ca_backboardd_host_test.py C6F_ENCODE200 plan_ms. I will not touch air_bridge.rs.
